meta_data.base_class: Calculates <a bundle of key statistical measures>. This is a general-purpose tool that takes a dataset and returns a bundle of core metrics (like mean, median, mode). The subclass tools would calculate only one specific metric.
meta_data.base_class_entity: key statistical measures, such as the mean, median, and mode

tool_template.name: compute_<class>
tool_template.description: This function calculates the <class> of a given numerical dataset.

data_path.description: Local path to the dataset file for calculating the statistical measure <class>. Should be in CSV format.

decimal_places.description: The number of decimal places to round the computed <class> statistics to.

column_name.description: The name of the column in the dataset file to perform the <class> calculation on.

missing_value_handling.description: The strategy for handling missing values in the dataset when calculating the <class> statistic, with options including 'ignore', 'fill_zero', 'fill_one'.

output_format.description: The desired format for the output file of the <class> calculation, with options including 'json', 'csv', 'text'.

filter_expression.description: A filter expression to apply to the data before the <class> calculation (e.g., 'Age > 18' or 'Category == "A"').
